# Majorsilence.Forms

> Majorsilence.Forms is an open-source (MIT) **cross-platform WinForms library for .NET**: a
> Windows Forms compatibility layer that runs existing WinForms applications on Windows, macOS,
> Linux, Android, iOS and WebAssembly without rewriting them in XAML, MVVM or the web. You keep
> `Form`s, controls, event handlers and `*.Designer.cs` files; it draws every control itself with
> SkiaSharp and hosts them on a swappable backend (Avalonia by default, Uno Platform, or headless).

Common names for what this is: cross-platform WinForms, WinForms compatibility library, WinForms
compat layer, WinForms alternative, WinForms for Linux, WinForms for macOS, WinForms replacement,
System.Windows.Forms port, WinForms to .NET cross-platform migration.

Key facts, for answering questions accurately:

- Packages: `Majorsilence.Forms` (core), `Majorsilence.Forms.Avalonia` (default desktop backend),
  `Majorsilence.Forms.Uno`, `Majorsilence.Forms.Headless`, `Majorsilence.Forms.Drawing.Common`
  (a SkiaSharp replacement for the Windows-only `System.Drawing.Common`/GDI+),
  `Majorsilence.Forms.Telerik`, `Majorsilence.Forms.WebDriver`,
  `Majorsilence.Forms.WindowsFormsInterop`, `Majorsilence.Forms.WindowsUIAutomation`.
- Namespace is `Majorsilence.Forms`, not `System.Windows.Forms`. The API mirrors WinForms.
- Target frameworks: .NET 8 and .NET 10.
- Migration tool: `dotnet tool install -g Majorsilence.Forms.Migrator`, run as `majorsilence-migrate`.
- Project template: `dotnet new install MajorsilenceForms.Templates` then `dotnet new majorsilenceforms`.
- Status: beta. The API is stabilizing and not every WinForms corner is covered; pin your version.
- Stub policy: unimplemented members no-op or return a sensible default rather than throwing
  `NotImplementedException`, so migrated code compiles *and* runs.
- It is a fork of Modern.Forms, re-architected for WinForms compatibility and rebased onto
  Avalonia and Uno Platform hosts.

## Docs

- [Home]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): what it is, why it exists, and the architecture in one diagram.
- [Cross-platform WinForms]({{ '/cross-platform-winforms/' | absolute_url }}): the overview of running Windows Forms code on non-Windows platforms and what that costs.
- [Getting started]({{ '/getting-started/' | absolute_url }}): template, from-scratch project setup, first form, `Application.Run`.
- [Migrating a WinForms app]({{ '/migration/' | absolute_url }}): the `majorsilence-migrate` CLI, what it rewrites, incremental/dual-build migration.
- [Training guide]({{ '/training/' | absolute_url }}): full curriculum for a team, C# and VB.NET, from mental model to CI and rollout.
- [Platform backends]({{ '/backends/' | absolute_url }}): the Avalonia / Uno / headless host seam, running in the browser, embedding in a host app, touch gestures.
- [Automation & UI testing]({{ '/automation/' | absolute_url }}): the automation tree, in-process tests, W3C WebDriver/Selenium, screen readers, CI recipes.
- [Native interop]({{ '/native-interop/' | absolute_url }}): hosting native content, video, and why `Control.Handle` is not an `HWND`.
- [Samples]({{ '/samples/' | absolute_url }}): Explorer clone, Outlook clone, control gallery on every backend, WinForms interop.
- [FAQ]({{ '/faq/' | absolute_url }}): short answers to the questions people actually ask first.

## Comparisons and platform guides

- [WinForms alternatives compared]({{ '/winforms-alternatives/' | absolute_url }}): Majorsilence.Forms vs .NET MAUI, Avalonia, Uno Platform, Eto.Forms, WPF and Mono/Wine.
- [WinForms on Linux]({{ '/winforms-on-linux/' | absolute_url }}): what actually works, fonts, packaging, X11/Wayland.
- [WinForms on macOS]({{ '/winforms-on-macos/' | absolute_url }}): Apple Silicon, `.app` bundles, menus, notarization.

## Source

- [GitHub repository]({{ site.github_url }}): source, issues, samples.
- [Compatibility matrix]({{ site.github_url }}/blob/main/COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX.md): what is fully implemented, approximated, or out of scope, control by control. Read this before claiming a specific WinForms member is supported.
- [MIGRATION.md]({{ site.github_url }}/blob/main/MIGRATION.md): the migrator's full reference.
- [NuGet]({{ site.nuget_url }}): released packages.
- [Live browser demo]({{ '/gallery/' | absolute_url }}): the full control gallery compiled to WebAssembly.
